details.description: Base Voicemail is a speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Base tier, derived from Deepgram's base-phonecall model and optimized for low-bandwidth audio clips from a single speaker, such as voicemail recordings. Base models are built on Deepgram's end-to-end deep learning speech-to-text architecture. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview currently groups the Base tier, together with Enhanced and Nova 1, under "Legacy Models", behind its newer Nova-3 and Flux offerings.
advantages: Deepgram describes it as optimized for low-bandwidth audio clips with a single speaker, derived from its base-phonecall model.
Deepgram describes Base-tier models as offering a solid combination of accuracy and cost effectiveness, built on its end-to-end deep learning speech-to-text architecture.
disadvantages: Deepgram groups the Base tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview, alongside Enhanced and Nova 1.
Deepgram states its Enhanced-tier models generally have higher accuracy and better word recognition than Base models, including significantly better handling of uncommon words.
Supports English only, per Deepgram's language documentation.
Tuned specifically for single-speaker voicemail-style clips rather than general-purpose or multi-speaker audio.
use_cases: Transcribing voicemail messages from a single speaker
Transcribing other low-bandwidth, single-speaker audio clips

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to base-voicemail were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. developers.deepgram.com/docs/models-languages-overview has a top-level 'Legacy Models' heading whose subsections are, in order, Nova, Enhanced, Base, Deepgram Whisper Cloud, placed after the current Flux, Nova-3 and Nova-2 sections; the catalog carries no deprecation_date for this model.
